name: Enshrouded
tagline: Native connector for an Enshrouded dedicated server: one dbghelp.dll next to the server exe.
requirements: File access to the Enshrouded dedicated server folder

assets.label: Plugin
assets.hint: Copy dbghelp.dll next to enshrouded_server.exe and start the server; it creates takaro\plugin.json, where you paste the registration token (saving is enough, no restart); the zip includes install, upgrade and rollback instructions.
